assertion.text:
Erdős Problem #302: declared status 'open'. Formalized: no. Let $f(N)$ be the size of the largest $A\subseteq \{1,\ldots,N\}$ such that there are no solutions to\[\frac{1}{a}= \frac{1}{b}+\frac{1}{c}\]with distinct $a,b,c\in A$?

Estimate $f(N)$. In particular, is $f(N)=(\tfrac{1}{2}+o(1))N$? Prize: no. OEIS: A390395. Tags: number theory, unit fractions.
